narrative: In the account book. The account book open. One sentence under a rule. The coffer across the room is shut, and it is not opened. No column of figures is touched. In the account book. The same sentence. The coffer has not moved. No total is written anywhere on the page.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote that the king ended, and did not count the coffer.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on ledger in Not yet shewn
